
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/chaoguo1234/p/19740806" title="发布于 2026-03-19 21:03">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">__block 变量内存布局详解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        __block 变量内存布局详解
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="1-内存布局">1 内存布局</h1>
<p>按照<code>LLVM</code>工程源码<code>Block_private.h</code>中的定义，<code>__block</code>变量的内存布局如下:</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">struct Block_byref {
    void *isa;
    struct Block_byref *forwarding;
    int flags; 
    int size;
    // 可选
    void (*byref_keep)(struct Block_byref *dst, struct Block_byref *src);
    // 可选
    void (*byref_destroy)(struct Block_byref *);
    // 可选
    void *variable_layout;
    // 变量
    Type variable;
};
</code></pre>
<p><code>isa</code>通常会被赋值为<code>0</code>，后面会有介绍。</p>
<p><code>forwarding</code>指针在<code>__block</code>变量定义时会指向<code>Block_byref</code>自身。</p>
<p>当<code>Block</code>发生<code>copy</code>时它的值会有变动，会放到<code>Block</code>的<code>copy</code>中写。</p>
<p><code>flags</code>是标志位，后面会有介绍。</p>
<p><code>size</code>是当前结构体所占用的字节大小。</p>
<p><code>byref_keep</code>与<code>Block</code>的<code>copy</code>相关，只有在满足条件时才有，后面会有介绍。</p>
<p><code>byref_destory</code>与<code>Block</code>的释放相关，只有在满足条件时才有，后面会有介绍。</p>
<p><code>variable_layout</code>在<code>__block</code>修饰结构体<code>Struct</code>时才会有，后面会介绍。</p>
<p><code>variable</code>是被定义成<code>__block</code>的变量。</p>
<p><img alt="__block内存布局" width="2413" height="2336" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/489427/202603/489427-20260319210253318-1428717413.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>从上图可以看到，当一个<code>Block</code>捕获了一个<code>__block</code>变量时，它的<code>Block_Descriptor</code>中会有<code>copy_helper</code>和<code>dispose_helper</code>。</p>
<p>因为<code>Block_byref</code>也有<code>isa</code>指针，虽然它不能作为一个<code>OC</code>对象看待，但是从结构上看，也符合<code>BLOCK_HAS_COPY_DISPOSE</code>被设置的条件。</p>
<p>但是结构体<code>Block_byref</code>中的<code>byref_keep</code>和<code>byref_destroy</code>仍是可选的。</p>
<p>下面用一个例子来直观感受一下:</p>
<pre><code class="language-objectivec">void blockTest() {
  // __block 变量
  __block int bi = 4;
  void(^blk)(int, int, int) = ^(int i, int j, int k) {
    int result = i + j + k + bi;
    NSLog(@"%d", result);
  };
  
  // block 外操作 bi
  bi++;
}
</code></pre>
<p>变量<code>bi</code>是一个<code>__block</code>变量。</p>
<p>使用<code>clang</code>的<code>rewirte-objc</code>将上面的代码重写为<code>c++</code>代码如下:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void blockTest() {
  // __block 变量
  __attribute__((__blocks__(byref))) __Block_byref_bi_0 bi = {(void*)0,(__Block_byref_bi_0 *)&amp;bi, 0, sizeof(__Block_byref_bi_0), 4};
  void(*blk)(int, int, int) = ((void (*)(int, int, int))&amp;__blockTest_block_impl_0((void *)__blockTest_block_func_0, &amp;__blockTest_block_desc_0_DATA, (__Block_byref_bi_0 *)&amp;bi, 570425344));
  // block 外操作 bi
  (bi.__forwarding-&gt;bi)++;
}
</code></pre>
<p>可以看到<code>__block</code>变量被编译后，成为了<code>Block_byref</code>结构体:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">struct __Block_byref_bi_0 {
  void *__isa;
__Block_byref_bi_0 *__forwarding;
 int __flags;
 int __size;
 int bi;
};
</code></pre>
<p>即使在<code>Block</code>外部访问<code>bi</code>变量，也是通过这个结构体的<code>forwarding</code>指针进行访问。</p>
<p>在<code>Block</code>内部访问<code>bi</code>变量，也是通过<code>forwarding</code>指针:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">struct __blockTest_block_impl_0 {
  struct __block_impl impl;
  struct __blockTest_block_desc_0* Desc;
  // Block 捕获的 __block 变量 bi
  __Block_byref_bi_0 *bi; // by ref
};


static void __blockTest_block_func_0(struct __blockTest_block_impl_0 *__cself, int i, int j, int k) {
  __Block_byref_bi_0 *bi = __cself-&gt;bi; // bound by ref
    
    // Block 内部访问 bi 变量
    int result = i + j + k + (bi-&gt;__forwarding-&gt;bi);
    NSLog((NSString *)&amp;__NSConstantStringImpl__var_folders_p6_jy49zvqx2656qb8rbq64hc_w0000gn_T_Block_de3226_mi_0, result);
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>forwarding</code>指针的作用会放到<code>Block</code>的<code>copy</code>中写。</p>
<h1 id="2-isa">2 isa</h1>
<p><code>__block</code>变量结构体的<code>isa</code>指针会固定设置为<code>0</code>。</p>
<h1 id="3-flags">3 flags</h1>
<p>在<code>LLVM</code>工程源码<code>CGBlocks.h</code>中定义了<code>flags</code>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">// Flags stored in __block variables.
enum BlockByrefFlags {
  BLOCK_BYREF_HAS_COPY_DISPOSE         = (1   &lt;&lt; 25), // compiler
  BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_MASK              = (0xF &lt;&lt; 28), // compiler
  BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_EXTENDED          = (1   &lt;&lt; 28),
  BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_NON_OBJECT        = (2   &lt;&lt; 28),
  BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_STRONG            = (3   &lt;&lt; 28),
  BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_WEAK              = (4   &lt;&lt; 28),
  BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_UNRETAINED        = (5   &lt;&lt; 28)
};
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="__block flags" width="4402" height="1809" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/489427/202603/489427-20260319210311639-1588863298.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1 id="31-block_byref_has_copy_dispose">3.1 BLOCK_BYREF_HAS_COPY_DISPOSE</h1>
<p>设置这个标志的条件和<code>Block</code>结构体类似:<br>
<code>1</code> <code>__block</code>变量本身就是一个结构体；</p>
<p><code>2</code> <code>__block</code>变量是一个<code>OC</code>对象；</p>
<p><code>3</code> <code>__block</code>变量是一个<code>C++</code>对象。</p>
<p>具体的设置规则，可以参看<code>LLVM</code>源码<code>CGBlocks.cpp</code>中的函数:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">BlockByrefHelpers *
CodeGenFunction::buildByrefHelpers(llvm::StructType &amp;byrefType,
                                   const AutoVarEmission &amp;emission)
</code></pre>
<p>只有能成功创建<code>helper</code>函数的<code>Block_byref</code>结构体，才会设置这个标志。</p>
<p>具体代码可以参看<code>LLVM</code>源码<code>CGBlocks.cpp</code>中的函数:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void CodeGenFunction::emitByrefStructureInit(const AutoVarEmission &amp;emission) {
  ...

  // Build the byref helpers if necessary.  This is null if we don't need any.
  BlockByrefHelpers *helpers = buildByrefHelpers(*byrefType, emission);

  ...

  BlockFlags flags;
  if (helpers) flags |= BLOCK_BYREF_HAS_COPY_DISPOSE;

  ...
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="32-block_byref_layout_mask">3.2 BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_MASK</h1>
<p>这是一个<code>4bit</code>的掩码，可以从<code>flags</code>中取出取出对应的枚举字段。</p>
<h1 id="33-block_byref_layout_extend">3.3 BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_EXTEND</h1>
<p>如果<code>__block</code>变量是一个结构体或者是一个<code>C++</code>对象<code>(C++</code>里结构体和<code>class</code>可以互用<code>)</code>，那么这个标志会被设置。</p>
<p>同时，<code>Block_byref</code>结构体中的<code>variable_layout</code>会有值。</p>
<p><code>variable_layout</code>描述了被捕获的结构体中，各个成员变量的类型以及占用的字节数。</p>
<p>对于<code>variable_layout</code>的解析虽然有点复杂，但是实际测试中并没有发现它的用处，即使在<code>Block</code>拷贝时也没有用。</p>
<p>有兴趣的可以继续往下看。</p>
<p>比如有如下的结构体:</p>
<pre><code class="language-objectivec">typedef struct S {
  int i;
  X *x; // X 是 OC 对象
};

void blockTest() {
  __block S s;
  s.i = 1;
  s.x = [X new];
  
  void(blk)(int, int, int) = ^(int i, int j, int k) {
    int result = i + j + k + s.i;
    NSLog(@"%@", result);
  };
}
</code></pre>
<p>上面代码中的<code>Block</code>捕获了一个结构体<code>__block S</code>。</p>
<p>我们使用<code>lldb</code>打印对应的内存值进行查看:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">(lldb) po [blk description]
&lt;__NSMallocBlock__: 0x600000c00090&gt;

# Block 内存值
(lldb) x/8g 0x600000c00090
0x600000c00090: 0x00000001f2d7bb78 0x00000000c3000002
0x600000c000a0: 0x00000001048c80dc 0x00000001048d4240
0x600000c000b0: 0x0000600001700100 

# Block_byref 内存值
(lldb) x/8g 0x0000600001700100
0x600001700100: 0x0000000000000000 0x0000600001700100
0x600001700110: 0x0000004013000004 0x00000001048c800c
0x600001700120: 0x00000001048c8070 0x00000001048ce87a
0x600001700130: 0x0000000000000001 0x00006000000150a0

# variable_layout 内存值
(lldb) x/8g 0x00000001048ce87a
0x1048ce87a: 0x6b636f6c42003020
</code></pre>
<p><code>Block_byref</code>内存值<code>0x0000004013000004</code>就是<code>size+flags</code>。</p>
<p>分析<code>0x0000004013000004</code>的低<code>32bit</code>，它的第<code>28bit</code>正好是<code>1</code>，说明<code>BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_EXTEND</code>被设置了。</p>
<p>接下来再看<code>variable_layout</code>。</p>
<p><code>variable_layout</code>是一个指针，指向的内存中的值是<code>0x6b636f6c42003020</code>。</p>
<p>对于<code>0x6b636f6c42003020</code>，需要从右向左一个字节一个字节的解析，直到遇到<code>00</code>为止。</p>
<p>每一个字节的高<code>4bit</code>定义了数据的类型，低<code>4bit</code>定义了数据占用的字节数。</p>
<p>高<code>4bit</code>的枚举值定义在<code>LLVM</code>源码<code>CGObjcCMac.cpp</code>中:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">enum BLOCK_LAYOUT_OPCODE {
    /// An operator which affects how the following layout should be
    /// interpreted.
    ///   I == 0: Halt interpretation and treat everything else as
    ///           a non-pointer.  Note that this instruction is equal
    ///           to '\0'.
    ///   I != 0: Currently unused.
    BLOCK_LAYOUT_OPERATOR            = 0,

    /// The next I+1 bytes do not contain a value of object pointer type.
    /// Note that this can leave the stream unaligned, meaning that
    /// subsequent word-size instructions do not begin at a multiple of
    /// the pointer size.
    BLOCK_LAYOUT_NON_OBJECT_BYTES    = 1,

    /// The next I+1 words do not contain a value of object pointer type.
    /// This is simply an optimized version of BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYTES for
    /// when the required skip quantity is a multiple of the pointer size.
    BLOCK_LAYOUT_NON_OBJECT_WORDS    = 2,

    /// The next I+1 words are __strong pointers to Objective-C
    /// objects or blocks.
    BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG              = 3,

    /// The next I+1 words are pointers to __block variables.
    BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF               = 4,

    /// The next I+1 words are __weak pointers to Objective-C
    /// objects or blocks.
    BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK                = 5,

    /// The next I+1 words are __unsafe_unretained pointers to
    /// Objective-C objects or blocks.
    BLOCK_LAYOUT_UNRETAINED          = 6

    /// The next I+1 words are block or object pointers with some
    /// as-yet-unspecified ownership semantics.  If we add more
    /// flavors of ownership semantics, values will be taken from
    /// this range.
    ///
    /// This is included so that older tools can at least continue
    /// processing the layout past such things.
    // BLOCK_LAYOUT_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN = 7..10,

    /// All other opcodes are reserved.  Halt interpretation and
    /// treat everything else as opaque.
  };
</code></pre>
<p>上面枚举中的<code>word-size</code>是一个指针真用的字节数，<code>64bit</code>的机器上通常是<code>8</code>字节:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">// CGObjcMac.cpp
llvm::Constant *CGObjCCommonMac::getBitmapBlockLayout(bool ComputeByrefLayout) {
  ...
  // Word Size 的大小
  unsigned WordSizeInBits = CGM.getTarget().getPointerWidth(LangAS::Default);
  ...
}
</code></pre>
<p>现在让我们从右向左解析<code>0x6b636f6c42003020</code>。</p>
<p>第一个字节是<code>20</code>，高<code>4bit</code>是<code>2</code>，代表<code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_NON_OBJECT_WORDS</code>。</p>
<p>这个值说明当前数据类型是一个非对象类型，参考结构体<code>S</code>的定义，符合预期。</p>
<p>低<code>4bit</code>是<code>0</code>，参考<code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_NON_OBJECT_WORDS</code>中的注释，它代表接下来<span class="math inline">\((0 + 1) * word\_size\)</span>个字节都是非对象类型。</p>
<p>第二个字节是<code>30</code>，高<code>4bit</code>是<code>3</code>，代表<code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG</code>。</p>
<p>这个值说明说明当前数据类型是一个<code>OC</code>对象<code>Strong</code>指针，参考结构体<code>S</code>的定义，符合预期。</p>
<p>低<code>4bit</code>时<code>0</code>，参考<code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG</code>中的注释，它代表接下来<span class="math inline">\((0 + 1) * word\_size\)</span>个字节都是<code>OC</code>对象<code>Strong</code>指针，也就是占用<code>8</code>字节。</p>
<p>第三个字节是<code>00</code>，高<code>4bit</code>是<code>0</code>，代表<code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_OPERATOR</code>。</p>
<p>这个值说明解析应该停止。</p>
<p>这种情形下，低<code>4bit</code>总是<code>0</code>。</p>
<p>如果被捕获的结构体比较大，则需要解析连续的内存值。</p>
<p>比如有下面的结构体:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">typedef struct S {
    int ai;
    BlockX *a;
    int bi;
    BlockX *b;
    int ci;
    BlockX *c;
    int di;
    BlockX *d;
    int ei;
    BlockX *e;
};
</code></pre>
<p>使用<code>lldb</code>查看<code>variable_layout</code>的内存值为:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">(lldb) x/8g 0x000000010017aa1a
0x10017aa1a: 0x3020302030203020 0x6b636f6c42003020
</code></pre>
<p>解析的时候，从第一条内存最右边开始，然后接着是第二条内存最右边，直到遇到<code>00</code>结束。</p>
<p><code>variable_layout</code>的值还有一种内联形式。</p>
<p>如果一个结构体或者<code>C++</code>对象里只有<code>enum BLOCK_LAYOUT_OPCODE</code>中定义的如下类型的成员变量:</p>
<ul>
<li><code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG</code></li>
<li><code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF</code></li>
<li><code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK</code></li>
</ul>
<p>并且每种类型的成员变量都是按顺序连续分布，那么<code>variable_layout</code>就会使用内联形式。</p>
<p><code>variable_layout</code>指针本身的值，就会变成<code>0x0000000000000xyz</code>的形式。</p>
<p>其中<code>x</code> <code>y</code> <code>z</code>都是<code>4bit</code>。</p>
<p><code>x</code>表示<code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG</code>的个数；</p>
<p><code>y</code>表示<code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF</code>的个数；</p>
<p><code>z</code>表示<code>BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK</code>的个数。</p>
<p>但是如果<code>variable_layout</code>的值大于等于<code>(1 &lt;&lt; 12)</code>，那么还是会回退到普通的情形。</p>
<p>比如下面代码中:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">typedef struct S {
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG *x1;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG *x2;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF *y1;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF *y2;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK *z1;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK *z2;
};
</code></pre>
<p>就可以使用<code>variable_layout</code>的内联形式， <code>variable_layout</code>本身的值为<code>0x0000000000000222</code>。</p>
<p>如果某种类型没有，那么<code>variable_layout</code>中对应位置就是<code>0</code>，比如:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">typedef struct S {
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG *x1;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG *x2;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK *z1;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK *z2;
};
</code></pre>
<p>那么<code>variable_layout</code>本身的值为<code>0x0000000000000202</code>。</p>
<p>如果类型出现的顺序不对，<code>variable_layout</code>也不会使用内联形式，比如:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">typedef struct S {
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF *y1;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF *y2;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG *x1;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG *x2;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK *z1;
  BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK *z2;
};
</code></pre>
<p>那么<code>variable_layout</code>仍使用普通形式。</p>
<p>有关<code>variable_layout</code>的内联形式，定义在<code>LLVM</code>源码的<code>CGObjcMac.cpp</code>中:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">/// InlineLayoutInstruction - This routine produce an inline instruction for the
/// block variable layout if it can. If not, it returns 0. Rules are as follow:
/// If ((uintptr_t) layout) &lt; (1 &lt;&lt; 12), the layout is inline. In the 64bit
/// world, an inline layout of value 0x0000000000000xyz is interpreted as
/// follows: x captured object pointers of BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG. Followed by y
/// captured object of BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF. Followed by z captured object of
/// BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK. If any of the above is missing, zero replaces it. For
/// example, 0x00000x00 means x BLOCK_LAYOUT_STRONG and no BLOCK_LAYOUT_BYREF
/// and no BLOCK_LAYOUT_WEAK objects are captured.
uint64_t CGObjCCommonMac::InlineLayoutInstruction(
    SmallVectorImpl&lt;unsigned char&gt; &amp;Layout)
</code></pre>
<p>方法上面的注释已经解释的很清楚了。</p>
<h1 id="34-block_byref_layout_non_object">3.4 BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_NON_OBJECT</h1>
<p>当<code>__block</code>变量是一个非对象类型，比如<code>int</code>时，会设置这个标志。</p>
<h1 id="35-block_byref_layout_strong">3.5 BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_STRONG</h1>
<p>当<code>__block</code>变量是一个<code>Strong</code>类型的<code>OC</code>变量时，会设置这个标志。</p>
<h1 id="36-block_byref_layout_weak">3.6 BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_WEAK</h1>
<p>当<code>__block</code>变量是一个<code>Weak</code>类型的<code>OC</code>变量时，会设置这个标志。</p>
<pre><code class="language-objectivec">__block __weak X *x;
</code></pre>
<h1 id="37-block_byref_layout_unsafe_unretained">3.7 BLOCK_BYREF_LAYOUT_UNSAFE_UNRETAINED</h1>
<p>当<code>__block</code>变量被<code>__unsafe_unretained</code>修饰时，会设置这个标志。</p>
<pre><code class="language-objectivec">__block __unsafe_unretained X *x;
</code></pre>
<h1 id="38-other-flags">3.8 Other Flags</h1>
<p>除了<code>enum BlockByrefFlags</code>中定义的枚举之外，还有其他两个被使用的枚举:</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">emum {
 BLOCK_REFCOUNT_MASK =     (0xffff),
 BLOCK_NEEDS_FREE =        (1 &lt;&lt; 24),
}
</code></pre>
<p>这两个枚举和<code>Block</code>中的<code>flags</code>是通用的。</p>
<h1 id="39-block_refcount_mask">3.9 BLOCK_REFCOUNT_MASK</h1>
<p>表示引用计数计数掩码。</p>
<p>也就是说，<code>int</code>类型的<code>flags</code>并不是<code>32bit</code>都是作为标志，最低<code>16bit</code>用来表示<code>Block_byref</code>被引用的次数<code>retainCount</code>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">block_byref_retain_count = flags &amp; BLOCK_REFCOUNT_MASK
</code></pre>
<h1 id="310-block_needs_free">3.10 BLOCK_NEEDS_FREE</h1>
<p>当一个<code>Block_byref</code>是<code>copy</code>出来的，那么就会设置这个标志。</p>


</div>
